mancala.title: Mancala

rules.rule1: Pick a pit on your side and distribute stones counter-clockwise.
rules.rule2: If your last stone lands in your store, you get another turn.
rules.rule3: If your last stone lands in an empty pit on your side, capture it and the opposite pit's stones.
rules.rule4: The game ends when one side is empty. Remaining stones go to that player's store.
rules.rule5: The player with the most stones in their store wins!
rules.objectiveDesc: Collect more stones in your store than your opponent.
rules.setupDesc: Each player has 6 pits with 4 stones each, and 1 store on their right.
rules.gameplayDesc: Pick up all stones from one of your pits and drop them one by one counterclockwise.
rules.extraTurnDesc: If your last stone lands in your store, you get another turn.
rules.captureDesc: If your last stone lands in an empty pit on your side, capture that stone and all stones in the opposite pit.
rules.endDesc: Game ends when one side is empty. Remaining stones go to their owner's store.
